images.author: Noah Grossenbacher
images.why: Classic baobab avenue and dirt road against an orange sunset. Small visitors provide scale; the towering trees dominate.

images.author: Noah Grossenbacher
images.why: Alternative sunset composition with warm light, massive trunks and a strong road leading line. Small people remain visible.

images.author: Yasmine Arfaoui
images.why: Recognisable Morondava baobab alley with warm natural light and detailed trees. Photographer identifies sunrise rather than sunset.

images.author: Sheila C
images.why: Photographer-confirmed Okavango Delta aerial: a winding channel through green wetlands, with strong patterns for a near-square crop.

images.author: Ulrico Zampa
images.why: Location-confirmed Okavango Delta aerial showing water and surrounding vegetation; a landscape-focused alternative without a dominant human subject.

images.author: Philipp Angerhofer
images.why: Recognisable Étretat chalk arch and offshore needle, with bright cliffs and blue water. Strong landmark grouping for the poster crop.

images.author: Clément Rémond
images.why: Classic arch-and-needle coastal view with turquoise sea, white chalk and green cliff tops.

images.author: Allyson Beaucourt
images.why: Sweeping Étretat arch-and-needle view with green headland and turquoise water; cloudier, moodier alternative.

images.author: Andrew Svk
images.why: Distinctive umbrella-shaped dragon's blood tree on rocky Socotra terrain; a clear single-tree focal point for a 9:10 crop.

images.author: Andrew Svk
images.why: Location-confirmed Socotra dragon's blood tree grove, emphasising the characteristic umbrella crowns and plateau landscape.

images.author: Andrew Svk
images.why: Wide hillside forest of dragon's blood trees with repeated umbrella silhouettes; softer cloudy light and extensive landscape context.

images.author: Michael Schofield
images.why: Recognisable Ko Tapu needle rising from green water, with distant forested islands and blue sky; compact landmark suits a near-square crop.

images.author: Sven
images.why: Phang Nga Bay aerial with layered limestone islands, mangroves and blue-green water; broad landscape alternative.

images.author: Gergana Ivanova
images.why: Classic James Bond Island view framed by larger forested cliffs, with emerald water and a central needle; softer, hazier light.
